exam_facts.note: Physical p7 (printed p5) states the knowledge test is 25 questions with 20 correct answers required to pass; question_count 25 is verbatim. passing_percent 80 is 20/25 arithmetic, not a printed figure (same convention as the NY intake). The page also requires a vision test before the license and notes the test is based on this manual with sample tests on the DMV mobile app. No time limit is stated anywhere in the handbook (full-text grep pass|percent|questions|correct reviewed) — null is a genuine absence, not imported from memory.
